kanzAlMahalliRecord.statement: The mother takes one third of the post-wife-share remainder in the wife-and-parents case, while eligible wives collectively take the wife category's quarter.

khulasaRecord.statement: The named case uses the wife category's quarter before the mother's remainder-third; the separately corroborated spouse-group atom validates one through four wives sharing that quarter collectively.

sourceAgreement.detail: The admitted wife-group rule supplies the complete collective-share semantics, and both Umariyyatayn sources apply the mother's rule to the remainder after that spouse-category share.

conditions: The complete heir set is two, three, or four eligible wives, mother, and father.
No descendant or additional heir changes the named wife-and-parents configuration.
KZ-FR-006-WIVES-ONE-QUARTER validates and divides the collective wife-group share.
exclusions: One wife remains covered by KZ-FR-015-WIFE-MOTHER-FATHER.
Invalid wife counts and additional heirs are excluded.
